function: Excluded (function): the learned LSTM adaptively sets the RIS reflection pattern and a DNN estimates the UE position, i.e. indoor uplink localization, an excluded function (p. 1, p. 3).
notes: Reason function: the learned method solves positioning. p. 1: "This letter investigates an uplink pilot-based wireless indoor localization problem"; p. 3: "The RIS-aided localization problem is that of minimizing the error between the estimated location p̂ and the actual location p". The RIS phases are learned only as active sensing for localization (metric: localization accuracy), not for communication, so area 3 does not apply. PDF title and authors match the DOI (Crossref).
